name: Auto Child Education (1.2)
short_description:
Stop-gap update of Auto Child Education by victoriaposting (https://steamcommunity.com/id/victoriaposting) for EU5 1.2.x compatibility.

v2.5: Updated for 1.2. Added compatibility with Orthodox Education (Fate of the Phoenix DLC). GUI now shows on-start effect tooltips for DLC educations.

All credit to victoriaposting for the original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3607293096
